# Requirements Quality Checklist: Production Hardening

**Purpose**: Validate completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of requirements in spec.md before implementation planning
**Created**: 2026-05-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## ErrorBoundary Design (FR-001, FR-002)

- [ ] CHK001 Is the ErrorBoundary specified as a React class component, given that functional components cannot catch rendering errors? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the exact MUI components for the fallback UI enumerated (Box, Typography, CircularProgress) with layout requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Clarification Q1]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the auto-recovery timeout duration explicitly quantified (5 seconds) with rationale for that specific value? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK004 Are timer cleanup requirements on unmount explicitly specified to prevent memory leaks? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities — Error Boundary]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements for multiple sequential errors defined — does the recovery timer reset correctly without stacking? [Coverage, Spec §US1-AS3]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the error boundary's wrapping scope specified — does FR-002 clearly define it wraps the entire app at root level? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the behavior when the fallback UI itself throws an error addressed in requirements? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Local Asset Migration (FR-003, FR-004)

- [ ] CHK008 Is the exact number of carousel images required specified (3)? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities — Carousel Assets]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the maximum file size per image documented as a requirement? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the storage path and import mechanism explicitly required (src/imports/ with Vite module imports)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Clarification Q5]
- [ ] CHK011 Is it clearly specified that the image array type remains `string[]` after migration? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the requirement for zero runtime network requests to image hosts measurable and testable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Are all existing external image URLs identified and enumerated for replacement? [Completeness, Gap]

## Accessibility — aria-live (FR-005, FR-006, FR-007)

- [ ] CHK014 Is the throttling interval for countdown announcements (once per minute) specified with rationale? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Clarification Q2]
- [ ] CHK015 Is it clearly specified that the visual countdown continues every second while only the accessibility text is throttled? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005 vs FR-006]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the specific aria-live value ("polite" vs "assertive") required for all live regions explicitly stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements for the announcements ticker's role and aria attributes specific enough (role="status", aria-live, role="marquee")? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Accessibility — aria-labels (FR-008)

- [ ] CHK018 Are all icon-only buttons explicitly enumerated (language toggle, donate, event mode, overlay close)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the specific label values defined for each button, including bilingual variants? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK020 Is it specified whether icon buttons should use aria-label, aria-labelledby, or visually hidden text? [Clarity, Gap]

## Accessibility — Focus Trap (FR-010, FR-011, FR-012)

- [ ] CHK021 Are the exact keyboard interactions specified: Tab, Shift+Tab, and Escape-to-close? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Clarification Q3]
- [ ] CHK022 Is it required that focus wraps from last element to first without escaping to the page behind? [Completeness, Spec §US4-AS2]
- [ ] CHK023 Is auto-focus on the first focusable element on mount explicitly required? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK024 Are the ARIA attributes for the dialog specified: role="dialog" and aria-modal="true"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the scope of the focus trap requirement clearly limited to the fundraising overlay only? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]

## Accessibility — Reduced Motion (FR-009)

- [ ] CHK026 Is it specified that reduced-motion preference affects ALL Framer Motion animations in the app, not just some? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the implementation mechanism specified (duration set to 0 when preference is active)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK028 Is it clear that CSS transitions are excluded from the reduced-motion requirement? [Scope, Spec §Assumptions]

## Service Worker — Optional (FR-013, FR-014, FR-015)

- [ ] CHK029 Is it explicitly required that the service worker is optional and can be disabled without affecting other features? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the caching strategy specified: cache-first for static assets and network-first for HTML? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK031 Are cache versioning requirements defined for cache busting on deploys? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the registration timing requirement specified (deferred, non-blocking first paint)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the offline indicator behavior specified: when shown, what content, what aria attributes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]

## Constitution Compliance (Articles I, II, IV, VII)

- [ ] CHK034 Are all styling requirements consistent with Article I (MUI-only, no Tailwind/utility classes)? [Consistency, Constitution Art. I]
- [ ] CHK035 Are type safety requirements consistent with Article II (TypeScript strict, no `any` in new code)? [Consistency, Constitution Art. II]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the "no new external dependencies" requirement (Article IV) explicitly stated and scoped? [Consistency, Constitution Art. IV, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK037 Do requirements align with Article VII (kiosk-first, auto-recover, never white screen)? [Consistency, Constitution Art. VII]
